site.name: Coordenada Geo
site.tagline: We turn geographic data into insights
site.description: Coordenada Geo turns geographic data into insights: interactive web apps with maps, charts and tables to analyse, present and share more easily. Your data stays in your browser.

hero.eyebrow: For those who see beauty in geographic data
hero.title: We turn geographic data into eureka.
hero.subtitle: Interactive maps, charts and tables, brought together in web apps that reveal the insights hidden in your data and take the discovery to anyone you choose to show. All in your browser, with your data under your control.
hero.note: Privacy by design: your data is processed in your browser and only leaves it if you ask and authorise.

problem.title: Your data is already good. It can get even better.

items.title: Easier to analyse
items.body: Map, charts and tables in one place to spot patterns, compare and filter without switching tools.

items.title: Easier to present
items.body: Instead of screenshots and static exports, an interactive app where your audience navigates, zooms and explores every detail of your work.

items.title: Easier to share
items.body: Your conclusions reach clients, managers and the general public without requiring specialised software or GIS knowledge.

problem.closing: You've done the hard part: producing the data. Now make it seen, understood and remembered. Coordenada Geo turns your file into an interactive app that showcases your work and takes your conclusions to the people who decide, without having to give up control over your data.

about.title: Over twenty years of geoprocessing, now as a product.
about.body: The Coordenada Geo team brings over twenty years of experience in geoprocessing and in developing technologies for modelling and analysis in geographic information systems. We bring that knowledge to a product that delivers the rigour of geospatial analysis to anyone who wants to analyse, present and share their data more easily.
bullets: Over 20 years of experience in geoprocessing and geographic information systems.
Experience developing technologies for geospatial modelling and analysis.
Privacy by design: your data stays in your browser.

purpose.title: Geographic information with more reach and more impact
purpose.body: Geographic data holds answers about health, production, the environment, security and the economy. But the impact of those answers depends on how many people can access and understand them. Our purpose is to make geographic information easier to access and to consume, so it reaches further and changes more decisions.

items.title: Precision
items.body: Technical and scientific rigour in methods and in how data is represented, so every map, chart and table shows what the data really says.

items.title: Collaboration
items.body: We build the product together with the people who use it, listening to analysts, companies and users to evolve the platform where it matters.

items.title: Adaptation
items.body: A flexible platform that adapts to different data types, fields of work and visualisation needs, and keeps evolving.

items.title: Revitalisation
items.body: We prioritise uses with a positive impact on people, ecosystems and territories.

platform.title: From file to interactive app, simply.
platform.body: Our goal is for the path from your file to an interactive app to be short, fast and free of technical know-how. It all happens in your browser.

steps.title: Open your file
steps.body: Select the file on your computer. It is read in your browser and never leaves your machine.

steps.title: Shape the data
steps.body: Choose how to present it: map, charts and tables arranged to tell what matters.

steps.title: Explore and share
steps.body: Browse the results and, if you want, share — only when and with whom you decide.

services.title: What changes when your data becomes an interactive app
services.intro: Less time preparing material, more impact for what you found.

items.title: Impress in the presentation
items.body: An interactive app, with zoom, layers and details on click for every element, shows far more than any screenshot or PDF.

items.title: Discover more in your data
items.body: Charts and tables built from the attributes reveal distributions, comparisons and patterns a map alone can't show.

items.title: No information gets lost
items.body: Every attribute in the file is available to query, sort and filter, by you and by whoever you invite.

items.title: Tell the story of the territory
items.body: Build a step-by-step narrative with text, images and camera moves on the map to guide readers to the conclusion.

items.title: Your data, under your control
items.body: Your data stays in your browser. Sending anything outside it is your decision, taken explicitly and with your authorisation.

items.title: No technical barrier
items.body: Creators don't need to code. Viewers don't need to install GIS software.

useCases.title: If you have geographic data, you have an app waiting

items.title: You're a geo analyst
items.body: Present your analysis in an interactive app instead of screenshots and PDFs. Your client explores, and your work gets the spotlight it deserves.

items.title: You lead a company or a team
items.body: Bring locations, areas and territorial indicators to the meeting or the report and decide with everyone looking at the same map.

items.title: You work in agriculture or the environment
items.body: Properties, protected areas, vegetation cover, deforestation: present the cartography of your work to producers, agencies, funders and communities.

items.title: You work in health, security, the economy or public policy
items.body: Cases, incidents, facilities, regional indicators: an interactive map conveys in seconds what a table takes pages to explain.

items.q: Does my data leave my computer?
items.a: No, unless you ask and authorise it. Your data is processed in your browser and only goes to our servers if you explicitly request it, for example to share.

items.q: Do I need to know GIS or how to code?
items.a: No. You open the file and the platform builds the interactive app. Whoever accesses it only needs a browser.
The formats most used in geoprocessing. The full list will be announced at launch, and you can tell us which format you're missing.
Sharing is optional and always your decision. Details of the sharing options will be announced at launch.

items.q: Does it work for any field?
items.a: Yes. Agriculture and the environment have a strong culture of geographic data, but the same goes for health, security, the economy, logistics and the public sector: where there is territory, there is something to show.
The platform is in beta. Terms will be announced at launch, and beta users talk directly with the team and help shape the product.
